thread:
oliver: Heads-up — the upcoming biweekly release is currently scheduled for Fri Apr 18 (Good Friday). That's a company holiday and will hit our freeze window. Proposing we shift the train +1 week to avoid lost reviewers. @jen @maria thoughts?
jen: +1 from me if we formally move it. Need to check CI backlog and cutoff dates though.
maria: Agreed. If we move, we should also nudge all teams about the earlier cutoff. I'll update the changelog template reminder.
kevin: FYI we have a couple of late feature PRs targeting release/x. If we move, please rebase onto release/x+1 and ping me for quick review.
sara: How does this affect Dedicated customers waiting for the latency fix? Any blockers for a patch release earlier?
oliver: Good Q — short answer: patch release can still be done mid-week off-cycle. This shift only changes the normal train date. We'll do a cherry-pick for the latency fix to main and run a hotfix if needed.
release-bot: CUTOVER REMINDER scheduled for 1768450000 (new proposed train). Calendar event: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234
rachel: Can someone add the holiday tag to the release calendar and set cutoff to 72h before new date? Otherwise engineers might miss it.
jen: I'll update the calendar and bump the cutoff. Also posting a note in #general later today.
maria: Changelog nudge text (feel free to copy): "Please add changelog entries to your PRs before the cutoff. Use the template:\n```\n- component: brief description (user-facing if applicable)\n```"
kevin: Re branch workflow: recommend creating a branch `release/x+1` off main now so PRs can land cleanly. Then we'll merge release/x -> release/x+1 as needed.
oliver: OK plan: 1) Move train +1 week. 2) Set cutoff = 72h before new date. 3) Hotfixes can go via main -> cherry-pick. 4) calendar + announcement by @jen. If no objections by EOD I'll update the release-docs and schedule.
sara: No objections from me. :thumbsup:
jen: Done — calendar updated and announcement queued. Thanks all.
oliver: Thanks — tagging this thread as resolved for now. If anything urgent, reopen here.
